answer: A tight ring of 29 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the marble calculation reruns each epoch, the bridge weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the opal settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 23% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
